argv:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
[Console]::OutputEncoding=New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
function Snapshot {
  @(Get-CimInstance Win32_PnPEntity | Where-Object {$_.Present -eq $true} | Select-Object PNPDeviceID,Name,Status,ConfigManagerErrorCode)
}
$prev=Snapshot
[ordered]@{kind='start';time=(Get-Date).ToString('o');devices=$prev} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress
$timer=[Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew();$polls=0;$changes=0
while($timer.Elapsed.TotalSeconds -lt 50) {
  Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
  $cur=Snapshot;$polls++
  $removed=@($prev | Where-Object {$_.PNPDeviceID -notin $cur.PNPDeviceID})
  $added=@($cur | Where-Object {$_.PNPDeviceID -notin $prev.PNPDeviceID})
  $changed=@($cur | Where-Object {$d=$_;$old=@($prev | Where-Object {$_.PNPDeviceID -eq $d.PNPDeviceID});$old.Count -eq 1 -and ($old[0].Status -ne $d.Status -or $old[0].ConfigManagerErrorCode -ne $d.ConfigManagerErrorCode)})
  if($removed.Count -or $added.Count -or $changed.Count) {
    $changes++
    [ordered]@{kind='change';time=(Get-Date).ToString('o');removed=$removed;added=$added;changed=$changed} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress
  }
  $prev=$cur
}
[ordered]@{kind='end';time=(Get-Date).ToString('o');elapsed=$timer.Elapsed.TotalSeconds;polls=$polls;changes=$changes;tablet=@($prev | Where-Object {$_.PNPDeviceID -match 'VID_0525|VID_18D1|VID_0000&PID_0002'})} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress
